SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.NICKNAME, U.TOTAL_AMOUNT, U.POINT,
G.GRADE_ID, G.GRADE_NAME, G.MIN_AMOUNT, G.DISCOUNT_RATE, G.DESCRIPTION, G.BENEFIT_TEXT FROM USER U LEFT JOIN USER_GRADE G ON U.GRADE_ID = G.GRADE_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT GRADE_ID AS GRADE_ID, GRADE_NAME AS GRADE_NAME, MIN_AMOUNT AS MIN_AMOUNT, DISCOUNT_RATE AS DISCOUNT_RATE, DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, BENEFIT_TEXT AS BENEFIT_TEXT FROM USER_GRADE ORDER BY GRADE_ID ASC
